EmailTemplate.description: Rejection notification sent to applicant when membership is not approved
EmailTemplate.name: CVMA Membership Rejected Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: CVMA Membership Application Status - {!Membership_Application__c.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Membership_Application__c.Applicant_First_Name__c},
Thank you for your interest in joining the Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association (CVMA) Chapter 20-7.
After careful review of your membership application, we regret to inform you that your application has not been approved at this time.
APPLICATION DETAILS: - Application ID: {!Membership_Application__c.Name} - Submitted: {!Membership_Application__c.Application_Date__c} - Reviewed: {!Membership_Application__c.Processing_Date__c}
This decision may be due to various factors related to our membership requirements or current chapter capacity. Please note that this decision does not reflect on your character or service to our country.
FUTURE OPPORTUNITIES: You may reapply for membership in the future. We encourage you to: - Review our membership requirements carefully - Connect with current CVMA members in your area - Participate in community events and veteran activities - Consider reapplying after addressing any requirements
SUPPORT FOR VETERANS: Even though your membership application was not approved, we remain committed to supporting all veterans. We encourage you to: - Connect with local veteran organizations - Participate in community veteran events - Access veteran support resources and services
If you have questions about this decision or would like guidance for future applications, please contact us at: Email: membership@cvma20-7.org Phone: (904) 555-CVMA
Thank you for your service to our country and your interest in CVMA.
Respectfully, CVMA Chapter 20-7 Officer Team Jacksonville, FL
Vets Serving Vets
